events.title: Celebrate Mean Girls Mania!
events.description:
Take Advantage of Mean Girls Offers Throughout Downtown Aurora! 

Shopping local? That’s so fetch!
Celebrate Mean Girls Mania with deals, promos, raffles, giveaways, and so much more at your favorite Downtown Aurora stores, restaurants, and galleries!

  

RESTAURANT/BAR/CAFÉ


Altiro Latin Fusion • 1 S. Stolp Ave. • Is There Alcohol in This?

Feel like Regina George’s mom with our 2 special Mean Girls cocktails and themed brunch with DJ, Glitter Station, and Mean Girls Photo Box.


Amore Mio Italian Restaurant • 33 W. New York St. • Is Butter a Carb?

$30 Girl Dinner Special: 1 Cocktail, 1 Pasta, and 1 Side Dish
Available Tuesday-Thursday.


Charlie’s Creamery • 6 E. Downer Pl. • Why Are You So Obsessed With Me?

Celebrate Mean Girls with our limited-edition dairy-free ‘Regina Raspberry’ flavor!
Ticket holders get $1 off their scoop when presenting a Paramount ticket stub.


Craft Urban • 41 S. Stolp Ave. • If You’re Gonna Drink, I’d Rather You Do it in the House

Enjoy our awesome Mean Girls themed cocktail menu.


Giardino Trattoria & Pizzeria • 12 N. River St. • That’s So Fetch

Every Wednesday from August 26 – October 11, 2026, wear pink to Giardino and enjoy a complimentary* appetizer or dessert, plus a voucher for a free* appetizer on your next visit.
Toast the occasion with our limited-edition Pink Cocktail, perfect for making memories with your people.
Reserve your table at eatatgiardino.com
*Limit one complimentary item per table, per visit. Up to $15 value. $10 minimum purchase required.


Kai Modern Japanese Kitchen • 2 N. River St. • I Want My Pink Shirt Back!

Join us for Pink Wednesdays and enjoy our Special Pink Cocktail
Every Wednesday from August 26 – October 11, 2026, wear pink to Kai and receive a complimentary* appetizer or maki roll, plus a coupon for a free* appetizer on your next visit.
Pair your meal with our exclusive Pink Wednesday Cocktail!
Make your reservation at kaijapanesekitchen.com
*Limit one complimentary item per table, per visit. Up to $15 value. $10 minimum purchase required.


La Quinta de los Reyes • 36 E. New York St. #52 • You Girls Keep Me Young

Grab our Pink Lime Margarita for just $8.
Dress in pink and get $5 dollars off, and don’t forget to stop by our photo display!
Only on Wednesdays.


Legacy Nutrition & Fitness • 77 S. River St. • Oh, it’s, Like, Slang. From England.

Show a Mean Girls ticket or confirmation and receive $1 off our That’s So Fetch themed drink.


Mich Big Taco • 31 N. Broadway • I Can’t Go to 🌮 🔔!

Enjoy our Taco Special before the showing or our Whole Enchilada and Pink Horchata during the movie!


Subway • 5 E. Downer Pl. • On Wednesdays, We Save at Subway

Get 10% off your order, only on Wednesdays.


Touché French Creole • 6 N. River St. • You Go, Glen Coco!

Every Wednesday from August 26 – October 11, 2026, wear pink to Touché and receive a complimentary* appetizer or dessert, plus a voucher for a free* appetizer on a future visit.
Sip our exclusive Pink cocktail creation and celebrate in French Creole style.
Book at touchefrenchcreole.com
*Limit one complimentary item per table, per visit. Up to $15 value. $10 minimum purchase required.


Two Brothers Roundhouse • 205 N. Broadway • I’m a Cool Mom 

Don’t miss our Cool Mom Martini—a bright and fresh martini with limoncello and raspberry liquor.
Tasty and (of course) pink!
Check out our Mean Girls photo display while you’re here.



  

RETAIL STORE/BOUTIQUE


Nide Jardin • 140 S. River St. Unit 106 • I Can’t Help it That I’m Popular

Wear pink on Wednesdays and get 10% off your purchase.


Offbeat Vintage Collective • 112 E. Galena Blvd. • Get in Loser, We’re Going Shopping

That’s so fetch!
Shop our Mean Girls inspired secondhand capsule collection.


Yellow Bird Books • 34 S. Stolp Ave. • She Doesn’t Even Go Here!

Show your plastics’ pride and shop our Mean Girls themed merchandise.



  

MUSEUM/GALLERY
French 75 Gallery & Lounge • 56 E. Galena Blvd. • The Limit Does Not Exist!

Get 10% off Mean Girls Themed Cocktails.


Society 57 • 100 S. River St. • I Wish I Could Bake a Cake Filled with Rainbows and Smiles

Enjoy our Mean Girls themed specialty coffee drink featuring cherry and chocolate.


Download the entire Mean Girls Event Calendar here for a handy guide!

Mean Girl offers vary. Check with local stores, restaurants, and other businesses for restrictions.

events.description: African American Parent Association Hosts 1st Annual School CarnivalThe African American Parent Association (AAPA) invites all East Aurora students, families, and community members to its 1st Annual School Carnival on Saturday, September 12, 2026!AAPA serves to bridge the connection between our schools and families while expanding academic and career resources for African American students across East Aurora. This free event brings our community together for an afternoon of classic carnival games, prizes, family fun, and complimentary food (available on a first-come, first-served basis while supplies last).To learn more about the group, explore upcoming meetings, and get involved, visit our [AAPA Parent Group Page] to view their accordion menu.Event Details:Date: Saturday, September 12, 2026Time: 12:00 PM – 3:00 PMLocation: East Aurora High SchoolAddress: 500 Tomcat Lane, Aurora, IL 60505Cost: Free (Open to all ages)Registration: Advance registration is required prior to attending.Please complete your registration online before attending the event. events.title: Halloween & Día de los Muertos Celebration
events.description:
Celebrate Halloween & Dîa De Los Muertos with Us! 

Bring your little ones in their costumes for a day of downtown Halloween fun!
You’ll enjoy family-friendly entertainment, music, crafts, trick-or-treating, and more during our Halloween & Dîa de los Muertos celebration!
Look forward to these Halloween festivities:

Día de los Muertos traditions
Live Entertainment
Local businesses handing out treats*
And a spectacular 12-minute drone show finale!


Here’s the schedule:

Afternoon: Downtown Trick-or-Treat (participating businesses will distribute treats)


The Día de los Muertos Cultural Experience:

Community Altar Display
Photo Opportunities
Arts and Crafts Stations
Face Painting inspired by Día de los Muertos traditions
Candy Station
Day of the Dead Bread and Hot Chocolate Station
Live Entertainment
Educational exhibits highlighting the meaning and history of the celebration will be present at the event or in the downtown area.


The Drone Show Grand Finale:

Our Downtown Drone Show will showcase colorful Halloween & Día de los Muertos images!


Don’t miss it!

*Halloween treats available while supplies last.
